integrity: The proof is mathematical; a standalone finite-instance checker supplies reproducibility but not independent proof certification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The linear-atom bound is not claimed optimal; the result covers formula validity for RmbC under BALFI semantics, not extended logics or arbitrary-premise consequence. A coNP algorithm might also follow from modal-fusion complexity through a succinct translation; that priority question is unresolved.
title: Linear-atom countermodels and coNP-completeness for RmbC
